what: While hovering a link or button, the icon inside (arrow badge · flower) beats like a heart, pulse-pulse and rest — 1.3x at 14%, back to rest at 28%, 1.15x at 42%, rest at 70%, repeating at 1.2s ease-in-out. When the hover ends it stops in place

options.[data-fx-part=beat]: Jumping child (if none, the element itself jumps)

from.where: shared.css a:hover .arrow — original keyframes heartbeat 1.2s ease-in-out infinite (arrow badge · menu flower · back to top · plus)
